description: scriptconv's Shami backend (Phonemizer.SHAMI), primarily a Levantine-Arabic-dialect phonemizer that also produced distinct, non-passthrough IPA-ish output for both en-US ('hello'->'həlˈo͡ʊ') and pt-PT ('mundo'->'mˈʌndo͡ʊ') in this venv - not English/Portuguese-aware, quality unverified for these languages, registered per this PR's literal working-matrix rule.
notes: Verified working for en-US and pt-PT in the shared venv, no extra package required, on 3 samples/lang. Intended-use language coverage (Levantine Arabic) is untested - no Arabic g2p dataset exists in this arena yet.
